arguments.command:
cd $PWD; sed -i 's/^export const MAX_CUT_OFFS/const MAX_CUT_OFFS/' src/conversation.ts; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='README.md'
s=open(p).read()
old="| `model_max_tokens` | Max output tokens for the custom model | No | `16384` |"
new="| `model_max_tokens` | Max output tokens for the custom model (reasoning counts toward it). A response that hits it with no tool call is continued, up to 3 times in a row and within `timeout`; partial text is posted, marked as cut off. If it keeps hitting the limit, pi posts an error that says so: raise this value, up to the provider's limit for the model | No | `16384` |"
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -rn "model_max_tokens" action.yml | head -3; npm run check 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Error|fail|FAIL|%|Tests|clone" | head -30
